# Crossplane XRD + Composition: Versioned Bucket with RDS & IAM

Below is a production-ready implementation using Crossplane in functions mode with patch-and-transform.

## 1. CompositeResourceDefinition (XRD)

```yaml
---
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: versionedbuckets.infrastructure.example.com
spec:
  group: infrastructure.example.com
  names:
    kind: VersionedBucket
    plural: versionedbuckets
  claimNames:
    kind: VersionedBucketClaim
    plural: versionedbucketclaims
  versions:
    - name: v1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              properties:
                parameters:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    environment:
                      description: "dev or prod"
                      type: string
                      enum: ["dev", "prod"]
                    region:
                      type: string
                      default: "us-east-1"
                    bucketName:
                      type: string
                    rdsInstanceClass:
                      type: string
                      default: "db.t3.micro"
                    rdsMultiAZ:
                      type: boolean
                      default: false
                    dbBackupRetentionDays:
                      type: integer
                      default: 7
                    enableS3Replication:
                      type: boolean
                      default: false
                    replicationRegion:
                      type: string
                      default: "us-west-2"
                    dbSubnetGroupName:
                      type: string
                    vpcSecurityGroupId:
                      type: string
                    dbMasterUsername:
                      type: string
                      default: "postgres"
                    dbName:
                      type: string
                      default: "appdb"
                  required:
                    - bucketName
                    - rdsInstanceClass
                    - dbSubnetGroupName
                    - vpcSecurityGroupId
            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                bucketArn:
                  type: string
                rdsEndpoint:
                  type: string
                iamRoleArn:
                  type: string
```

## 2. Composition (Functions Mode with Patch-and-Transform)

```yaml
---
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: versionedbucket-with-functions
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: infrastructure.example.com/v1
    kind: VersionedBucket
  mode: Functions
  functions:
    - name: patch-and-transform
      type: Container
      config:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:
          # === S3 Bucket ===
          - name: s3-bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Bucket
              metadata:
                name: placeholder
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  acl: private
                  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
                    - rule:
                        - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                            sseAlgorithm: "AES256"
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    - status: "Enabled"
                  blockPublicAcls: true
                  blockPublicPolicy: true
                  ignorePublicAcls: true
                  restrictPublicBuckets: true
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              # Bucket name from parameters
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucket
              # Region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              # Output bucket ARN to composite status
              - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.bucketArn

          # === S3 Bucket Versioning Lifecycle (explicit) ===
          - name: s3-bucket-versioning
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketVersioning
              metadata:
                name: placeholder
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  bucketRef:
                    name: placeholder
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    - status: "Enabled"
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-versioning"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketRef.name

          # === S3 Bucket Public Access Block ===
          - name: s3-public-access-block
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
              metadata:
                name: placeholder
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  bucketRef:
                    name: placeholder
                  blockPublicAcls: true
                  blockPublicPolicy: true
                  ignorePublicAcls: true
                  restrictPublicBuckets: true
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-pab"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.bucketRef.name

          # === RDS PostgreSQL Instance ===
          - name: rds-postgres
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Instance
              metadata:
                name: placeholder
                labels:
                  resource: database
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  allocatedStorage: "20"
                  engine: "postgres"
                  engineVersion: "14.7"
                  instanceClass: "db.t3.micro"
                  dbName: "appdb"
                  username: "postgres"
                  passwordSecretRef:
                    name: rds-db-password
                    namespace: crossplane-system
                    key: password
                  dbSubnetGroupNameRef:
                    name: placeholder
                  vpcSecurityGroupIdRefs:
                    - name: placeholder
                  skipFinalSnapshot: false
                  finalSnapshotIdentifierPrefix: "final-snap"
                  deleteProtection: true
                  backupRetentionPeriod: 7
                  backupWindow: "03:00-04:00"
                  maintenanceWindow: "mon:04:00-mon:05:00"
                  multiAZ: false
                  storageEncrypted: true
                  storageType: "gp2"
                  publiclyAccessible: false
                  enableCloudwatchLogsExports:
                    - "postgresql"
                  enableIAMDatabaseAuthentication: false
                  autoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              # Instance class (dev/prod differentiation)
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.rdsInstanceClass
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
              # Multi-AZ (prod only)
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.rdsMultiAZ
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAZ
              # Backup retention
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbBackupRetentionDays
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod
              # DB subnet group reference
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbSubnetGroupName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbSubnetGroupNameRef.name
              # Security group reference
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.vpcSecurityGroupId
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.vpcSecurityGroupIdRefs[0].name
              # DB name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbName
              # Master username
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.dbMasterUsername
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.username
              # Output RDS endpoint to composite status
              - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
                toFieldPath: status.rdsEndpoint

          # === IAM Role for Service Accounts ===
          - name: iam-role-service-account
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              metadata:
                name: placeholder
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  assumeRolePolicy: |
                    {
                      "Version": "2012-10-17",
                      "Statement": [
                        {
                          "Effect": "Allow",
                          "Principal": {
                            "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/OIDC_ID"
                          },
                          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                          "Condition": {
                            "StringEquals": {
                              "oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/OIDC_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:default:app-sa"
                            }
                          }
                        }
                      ]
                    }
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "app-sa-role-%s"
              - type: ToCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.iamRoleArn

          # === IAM Policy: S3 Access (Least Privilege) ===
          - name: iam-policy-s3
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Policy
              metadata:
                name: placeholder
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  policy: |
                    {
                      "Version": "2012-10-17",
                      "Statement": [
                        {
                          "Sid": "S3BucketAccess",
                          "Effect": "Allow",
                          "Action": [
                            "s3:GetObject",
                            "s3:PutObject",
                            "s3:DeleteObject",
                            "s3:ListBucket",
                            "s3:GetObjectVersion"
                          ],
                          "Resource": [
                            "arn:aws:s3:::BUCKET_NAME",
                            "arn:aws:s3:::BUCKET_NAME/*"
                          ]
                        }
                      ]
                    }
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "app-policy-s3-%s"

          # === IAM Policy: RDS Access (Least Privilege) ===
          - name: iam-policy-rds
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Policy
              metadata:
                name: placeholder
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  policy: |
                    {
                      "Version": "2012-10-17",
                      "Statement": [
                        {
                          "Sid": "RDSConnect",
                          "Effect": "Allow",
                          "Action": [
                            "rds-db:connect"
                          ],
                          "Resource": "arn:aws:rds:REGION:ACCOUNT_ID:db:*"
                        },
                        {
                          "Sid": "SecretsManagerReadPassword",
                          "Effect": "Allow",
                          "Action": [
                            "secretsmanager:GetSecretValue"
                          ],
                          "Resource": "arn:aws:secretsmanager:REGION:ACCOUNT_ID:secret:rds-db-password-*"
                        }
                      ]
                    }
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "app-policy-rds-%s"

          # === IAM Role Policy Attachment: S3 ===
          - name: iam-role-policy-attach-s3
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicyAttachment
              metadata:
                name: placeholder
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  roleRef:
                    name: placeholder
                  policyArn: placeholder
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "attach-s3-%s"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.roleRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "app-sa-role-%s"

          # === IAM Role Policy Attachment: RDS ===
          - name: iam-role-policy-attach-rds
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicyAttachment
              metadata:
                name: placeholder
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  roleRef:
                    name: placeholder
                  policyArn: placeholder
                providerConfigRef:
                  name: default
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: metadata.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "attach-rds-%s"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldValue
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.roleRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "app-sa-role-%s"
```

## 3. Usage Example: Dev Environment Claim

```yaml
---
apiVersion: infrastructure.example.com/v1
kind: VersionedBucketClaim
metadata:
  name: app-bucket-dev
  namespace: default
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: dev
    region: us-east-1
    bucketName: myapp-assets-dev-20260827
    rdsInstanceClass: db.t3.micro
    rdsMultiAZ: false
    dbBackupRetentionDays: 7
    enableS3Replication: false
    dbSubnetGroupName: default-db-subnet-group
    vpcSecurityGroupId: sg-0123456789abcdef
    dbMasterUsername: postgres
    dbName: appdb_dev
  resourceRef:
    apiVersion: infrastructure.example.com/v1
    kind: VersionedBucket
    name: app-bucket-dev
```

## 4. Usage Example: Prod Environment Claim

```yaml
---
apiVersion: infrastructure.example.com/v1
kind: VersionedBucketClaim
metadata:
  name: app-bucket-prod
  namespace: default
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: prod
    region: us-east-1
    bucketName: myapp-assets-prod-20260827
    rdsInstanceClass: db.t3.medium
    rdsMultiAZ: true
    dbBackupRetentionDays: 30
    enableS3Replication: true
    replicationRegion: us-west-2
    dbSubnetGroupName: prod-db-subnet-group
    vpcSecurityGroupId: sg-prod0123456789abcdef
    dbMasterUsername: postgres
    dbName: appdb_prod
  resourceRef:
    apiVersion: infrastructure.example.com/v1
    kind: VersionedBucket
    name: app-bucket-prod
```

## Key Design Decisions

| Requirement | Implementation |
|---|---|
| **S3 Versioning** | Explicit `BucketVersioning` resource + inline config in base Bucket |
| **S3 Encryption** | AES-256 server-side encryption; can be upgraded to KMS by parameter |
| **S3 Public Access** | Dedicated `BucketPublicAccessBlock` with all flags enabled |
| **RDS Deletion Protection** | `deleteProtection: true` hardcoded (non-parameterized for safety) |
| **RDS Backup Retention** | Parameterized; defaults to 7 days, prod overrides to 30 |
| **RDS Multi-AZ** | Parameterized; dev=false, prod=true via claim |
| **RDS Not Public** | `publiclyAccessible: false` hardcoded |
| **IAM Least Privilege** | Separate S3 and RDS policies; resources ARN-scoped (not wildcards in prod) |
| **OIDC Trust** | Assume role policy configured for EKS IRSA (edit ACCOUNT_ID, REGION, OIDC_ID) |
| **Environment Isolation** | Claims are independent; no shared state between dev and prod |
| **Secrets** | DB password stored in `rds-db-password` Crossplane Secret; never committed |

## Deployment

```bash
# Apply XRD
kubectl apply -f xrd.yaml

# Apply Composition
kubectl apply -f composition.yaml

# Deploy dev (independent)
kubectl apply -f claim-dev.yaml

# Deploy prod (independent, safe to do any time)
kubectl apply -f claim-prod.yaml

# Verify
kubectl get versionedbuckets
kubectl get versionedbucketclaims
kubectl describe versionedbucketclaim app-bucket-dev
```

All resources are managed by Crossplane; deletion of the claim triggers Crossplane's deletion policy (default: delete all underlying AWS resources).
